Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class ProcessService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.ProcessService
public final class ProcessService extends Object
Enumerates running processes and exposes terminate/kill/renice operations, backed by /proc and ProcessHandle.

Per-process CPU usage is computed from the delta of the kernel utime+stime counters between successive snapshot() calls, so a caller that refreshes on a timer gets a meaningful percentage. The first snapshot for a given process reports 0% (there is no previous sample yet).

Signalling a process we own uses ProcessHandle.destroy() / ProcessHandle.destroyForcibly(); processes owned by other users fall back to pkexec kill via PrivilegedRunner, which returns a structured result so the UI can prompt or explain rather than fail.
